artists.biography:
"The Anchoress is the Welsh multi-instrumentalist, songwriter and author Catherine Anne Davies (aka Catherine AD).
The Anchoress is the stage name of Welsh musician/songwriter Catherine Anne Davies, who also records under the nom de plume Catherine A.D. A self-taught multi-instrumentalist, chanteuse, and singer/songwriter specializing in a heady blend of gothic chamber pop and dark atmospheric art rock, Davies has drawn comparisons to PJ Harvey, Nick Cave, Anna Calvi, My Brightest Diamond, and Kate Bush. She issued a series of well-received independently released EPs before switching over to the Anchoress moniker in 2014 and issuing the single "One for Sorrow.. ~ James Christopher Monger
From March to Dec 2015, Davies performed in Simple Minds' live band, contributing additional guitar and keyboards. She met Jim Kerr through The Dark Flowers collective. She has also performed live with Ed Harcourt at Glastonbury Festival, as well as Martha Wainwright.
Davies has been described by NPR's Ann Powers as "Wales's (much more explicitly feminist) answer to Lana Del Rey."

perplexity.description:
Versions: Encore" by The Anchoress is a 2024 limited edition vinyl EP featuring six cover songs, including reinterpretations of tracks by Joy Division, The Smiths, Suede, and Blur. The musical style continues Catherine Anne Davies' exploration of atmospheric, introspective pop, characterized by her multi-instrumental and production skills that blend moody textures with emotive vocal delivery. This EP serves as a companion piece to her 2023 album "Versions," which also focused on re-imagined covers, showcasing her ability to transform well-known songs into distinctive, personal interpretations.

Positioned after her critically acclaimed original albums "Confessions of A Romance Novelist" and "The Art of Losing," which earned significant recognition including Welsh Album of the Year and nominations for the Welsh Music Prize, "Versions: Encore" highlights Davies' ongoing interest in reinterpretation and homage within her discography. Released on the Hiraeth label, the EP was well received by fans for its intimate and thoughtful approach to cover material, reinforcing The Anchoress' reputation for artistic depth and sonic sophistication in the pop genre.
